obfuscation_indicators: subject to adjustment in the future
risk_summary: The disclosure is largely quantified and provides useful segment, margin, currency, utilization, and tax details, with generally stable to positive operating performance. Key risk areas include currency headwinds, higher interest and operating costs, reliance on one-time tax benefits, non-GAAP adjustments, and actuarial estimates for insurance liabilities. Standard forward-looking disclaimers and extensive accounting caveats modestly reduce transparency but do not appear unusually evasive.
